title: Accounts Administrator

description:

title: Accounts Receivable Controller
description:
Accounts Receivable Controller
Nigel Wright are currently supporting a North Yorkshire based organisation with their temporary Accounts Receivable Controller requirement. This will be an initial 3 month assignment with hybrid working offered.

The Role
As Accounts Receivable Controller, you will:
- Manage the credit control process across a high-volume ledger
- Monitor aged debt and deliver against collection targets and KPIs
- Allocate payments and remittances accurately
- Reconcile debtor and control accounts
- Ensure invoices and credit notes are accurate, authorised and issued on time
- Maintain reliable records of rates, contract terms and billing arrangements
- Investigate billing discrepancies, unbilled income and changes affecting charges
- Resolve queries while maintaining positive customer relationships
- Strengthen policies and procedures covering income, sales ledger and aged debt
- Support revenue reporting and cash-flow forecasting

The Candidate
You will bring significant credit control experience, ideally gained in a comparable high-volume environment. You will have a strong understanding of sales ledger processes and the proven ability to reduce debt without compromising customer service.
Strong Excel skills, attention to detail and the ability to remain organised under pressure are essential. You will be proactive, comfortable working to deadlines and targets, and able to use your initiative while contributing effectively as part of a team.
Applications
Interested? Apply now!

title: Finance Assistant
description:
As a Finance Assistant, you will support the day-to-day finance function, assisting with transactional finance duties, reconciliations, month-end processes and finance administration.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established and growing organisation operating within the renewable energy sector,

Description
- Process purchase invoices, payments and employee expenses.
- Maintain purchase and sales ledgers.
- Reconcile bank accounts and supplier statements.
- Support credit control activities and chase outstanding debt.
- Assist with month-end procedures including journals and reconciliations.
- Maintain accurate financial records and documentation.
- Respond to internal and external finance queries.
- Process and update information within Xero and other finance systems.
- Support finance process improvement initiatives.
- Assist with transactional finance work arising from business acquisitions.
- Work closely with the Financial Controller and wider finance team.
- Ensure accuracy and attention to detail across all finance activities.

Profile

A successful 'Finance Assistant' should have:
- Previous experience in a Finance Assistant, Accounts Assistant or Assistant Accountant position.
- Strong purchase ledger and sales ledger experience.
- Experience completing bank and supplier reconciliations.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
- Experience using finance software, ideally Xero.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- The ability to work independently and manage a busy workload.
- Excellent communication skills.
- A proactive approach and willingness to support the wider team.
- Immediate availability or a short notice period.

Job Offer
- Temporary Finance Assistant opportunity.
- Hourly rate of £15 - £17 per hour.
- Hybrid working arrangement.
- Free Parking.
- Immediate start available.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Ledger Clerk
company: Optimum Recruitment Group Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:

You will be responsible for the supporting of processing sales orders, and to ensure the smooth flow of customers orders through the system, as well as maintaining various other office records and data bases as required.

This role would suit an experienced administrator who is happy to come in and get stuck into whatever requires doing within this small team.

Your key responsibilities will include:

Raising invoices weekly.

Undertaking certain sales administration duties as directed weekly, e.g. checking of sales orders.

Full holiday cover for sales administration team, including processing orders, speaking to customers, invoicing, printing delivery notes, filing.

Reception duties each Friday, and proving holiday cover whilst receptionist on holiday.

Scanning purchase invoices into scans folder.

Filing of paid invoices.

General office administration including cover for telephone, email etc as appropriate.

Ad hoc duties, including holiday cover for other office staff roles.

Core Competencies:

Numerate and literate, including good GCSEs or equivalent.

Computer literate, including MS Office and Accounting system skills.

Polite and courteous.

Excellent attention to detail.

Good communication and telephone skills.

Benefits:
- Company pension
- Free parking
- Life insurance
- On-site parking

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
An independent accountancy firm in Harrogate is looking to recruit a Payroll Administrator to join its team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with some payroll experience who is looking to develop their payroll experience. Applicants from both industry and practice backgrounds will be considered, with full training and ongoing support provided.

Responsibilities will include:
- Processing weekly, fortnightly and monthly payrolls for a portfolio of clients.
- Calculating statutory payments, including SSP, SMP and SPP.
- Processing starters, leavers and payroll amendments.
- Preparing and submitting RTI returns to HMRC.
- Assisting with pension submissions and auto-enrolment.
- Responding to client payroll queries.

The successful candidate will have:
- Payroll experience, gained in either industry or practice.
- Good attention to detail and organisational skills.
- A willingness to learn and develop their payroll knowledge.
- A friendly, approachable manner and good communication skills.

title: Payroll/Finance Administrator
description:
Full Job description

We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly organised and motivated Payroll/Finance Administrator to join our finance team in our head office in Harrogate.

Job Purpose:

Reporting to the Finance Manager, the Payroll / Finance Administrator is responsible for managing employee pay and supporting financial operations within an organisation. The role combines payroll processing with broader finance and administrative duties

Key Responsibilities
- Calculate wages, salaries, bonuses, and deductions
- Check and monitor commission calculations
- Ensure employees are paid accurately and on time
- Manage overtime, sick pay, and holiday pay with assistance of HR Department.
- Ensure payroll complies with tax laws (e.g. PAYE, National Insurance)
- Submit reports to HMRC and maintain payroll records
- Assist with budgeting and forecasting
- Process invoices and expenses
- Reconcile accounts and support audits
- Handle payroll queries and maintain employee records
- Input manual timesheets into payroll software
- Input payroll costs into project costing system
- Adhoc Financial Duties as required.

Key Skills
- Strong numerical and analytical skills
- Attention to detail and accuracy
- Knowledge of payroll systems (e.g. Sage, Xero, QuickBooks)
- Understanding of UK tax and employment regulations
- Good communication skills and confidentiality

Experience
- Background in accounting, finance, or business administration
- Experience with spreadsheets and financial software
